name: Asagi
source:
"What the hell do you mean by 'Hero'?! I failed the entrance exams once, then at long last made it to a national university! I don't give a damn about this world!"

The protagonist of this story.
He had passed university entrance examination, but was summoned to this world by Nirmo and others before he could pay the enrollment fee.
He was perplexed by being suddenly treated as a hero, but since he gets to have sex and it didn't sound so bad, he accepted the role without a second thought.
But as he gets to spend time and fight alongside the heroines, he gradually awakens to the role of the hero.
